text.en:
A new Section five is hereby inserted after Section four of Presidential Decree No. 852 which
shall read as follows:
"SECTION 5. All acts, decrees, orders, ordinances, rules and regulations, or parts thereof, which are
inconsistent with the provisions of this Decree are hereby repealed, amended or modified accordingly."
Section five of the same Decree is renumbered accordingly as Section six.

This Decree shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 22nd day of September in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-six.
